provenance.tool: Sound Equalization and Correction System 2 (SECS 2) Beta 1.1.0, Speaker Gallery (DCinside), GPL-3.0
provenance.exporter: tests/migration/export_goldens_secs2.py (no SECS code; calls the oracle and records its results)
provenance.numpy_dispatch: SIMD above the X86-64-v2 baseline disabled: the oracle's float64 transcendental functions are the C library's
provenance.configuration: positions = left ear, right ear of the aligned in-ear BRIRs (t0 = 0 for all, common time base); mains = all seven speakers, no subwoofers; MAIN_WEIGHT = MAIN_WEIGHT_LO = 1 (position 1 still drives the listening-position-only steps); SECS arrival delays set to zero after compute(); design_mimo's minimum-position rule lowered from 3 to 2 in memory

ir.construction: examples/secs2_inputs brir/*: open_recording_samples(…, None, 2.0) per file in that order, crop_heads(1.0), align_ipsilateral_all(IPSILATERAL_PAIRS, 30.0), align_onset_groups_peak_leftref(None), crop_tails(estimator) (24000 samples)

fields.supports: input -> support speaker -> 600 Hz FIR (support FIR convolved with the Fsiso low-pass, after the guard)
fields.level_db: support level relative to the correction filter energy
fields.ranges: support band (low, high) Hz or null
fields.late: the oracle's guard measures at the accepted scale; tail_change is its scaled form (dB x 0.15)
